buildCommand: FRONTEND_DIR=''; for d in frontend ../frontend PORTFOLIO/frontend ../PORTFOLIO/frontend; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then FRONTEND_DIR="$d"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$FRONTEND_DIR" ]; then echo 'Frontend directory not found'; pwd; ls -la; exit 1; fi; npm --prefix "$FRONTEND_DIR" install; npm --prefix "$FRONTEND_DIR" run build; rm -rf dist; cp -r "$FRONTEND_DIR/dist" dist
